title: Heat Map Triage
description: Decide what to work on next using the heat map and scoring system. Smallest × lowest = quickest win.
earned_from: baseline scoring revealed joints(0.5) as best target over randomness(2.0, 114 artifacts)

nodes.label: Run scoring across all sequences
nodes.detail: python tools/heat_map_generator.py OR the inline scoring one-liner from baseline.

nodes.label: Sort by: artifact_count * (8 - avg_score)
nodes.detail: This gives impact score. Small sequences with low scores are quickest wins.

nodes.label: Quick win or big impact?
nodes.detail: Quick win: 3-10 artifacts at 0-1/8. Big impact: 50+ artifacts at 1-2/8 (needs batch processing).

nodes.label: Load sequence-improve flow
nodes.detail: Small sequence: do it all in one session. Read code, batch metadata, visual upgrade, commit.

nodes.label: Use /ada-artifact-improver auto
nodes.detail: Large sequence: run the improver skill in batch mode. Process 10-20 per session.

summary: Score all. Sort by artifact_count × (8 - avg). Small×low = quick win. Large×low = batch job.
